meta.title: DSH Director
meta.description: Direct inside DSH while ZipX produces: premium films, multi-episode short dramas, creative videos and product videos. Script, storyboard, keyframes, voice, edit, quality gates and cost run in one conversation; every paid step is confirmed and the final cut exports for delivery.
